Georgia, Songti SC, Noto Serif SC, SimSun, serif
spacing: main content horizontal padding: 32px desktop / 10px mobile
detail hero to practice cadence measured in initial desktop/mobile cases
teaching section gap: 40px desktop/mobile source contract

sections.trigger: route links, community menu, language, theme color, color mode and search

assets.rights: Existing source-derived local QA asset; independent redistribution requires final brand asset replacement or rights confirmation.

responsive.desktop: 60px sticky single-row navigation with logo, links, search, language, theme and partner entry
responsive.mobile: 108px sticky two-row navigation; secondary desktop-only partner entry is hidden
source survey remains a fixed panel when shown; local QA may suppress it after the compatible persistence key is set

assets.rights: Source pronunciation asset is evidence-only; independent deployment requires a permitted local replacement or removal.

responsive.desktop: 916px content hero inside the detail shell; lead and native Demo follow the source vertical cadence
responsive.mobile: 370px content hero at x=10; previous/next pills, lead and Demo retain the measured source sequence

sections.trigger: select one of three radio answer labels

responsive.desktop: source practice panel follows the Demo with a 916px content width
responsive.mobile: single-column 370px practice panel follows the Demo without horizontal overflow

sections.trigger: read and copy the Agent prompt from the detail page

responsive.desktop: source prompt card follows Quick Check with measured 916px width
responsive.mobile: prompt card wraps within 370px and preserves readable line length

sections.trigger: native scroll to the usage teaching section

responsive.desktop: two-column source usage content with measured section spacing
responsive.mobile: single-column source usage content with 1654.5px measured height for HTML

sections.trigger: anatomy part buttons reveal the selected part

responsive.desktop: source anatomy visual and four explanatory cards in the measured desktop grid
responsive.mobile: source anatomy visual followed by the measured responsive card grid

responsive.desktop: four variant choices remain in the source horizontal teaching layout
responsive.mobile: variant choices use the measured single-column source cadence

sections.trigger: select one of four working contexts and run its local action

responsive.desktop: four source scene cards are shown in the measured vertical collection
responsive.mobile: four scene cards retain the source collection height and no horizontal overflow

sections.trigger: open the Selector Pro recommendation card

responsive.desktop: 916px recommendation card with source action preview

sections.trigger: read source references and footer links

responsive.desktop: references sit above the source footer with two linked reading items
responsive.mobile: references wrap to one column and stay within the viewport
